items.docs:
Retrieve Music On Hold Settings for a Workspace.

Music on hold is played when a caller is put on hold, or the call is parked.

Retrieving a workspace's music on hold settings requires a full, device or read-only administrator auth token with a scope of `spark-admin:telephony_config_read`.

items.docs:

Music on hold is played when a caller is put on hold, or the call is parked.

info.name: Assign or Unassign numbers associated with a specific workspace

params.name: orgId
params.description: ID of the organization within which the workspace resides. Only admin users of another organization (such as partners) may use this parameter as the default is the same organization as the token used to access the API.

items.docs:
Assign or unassign alternate phone numbers associated with a specific workspace.

Each location has a set of phone numbers that can be assigned to people, workspaces, or features. Phone numbers must follow the E.164 format for all countries, except for the United States, which can also follow the National format. Active phone numbers are in service.

This API requires a full, user or location administrator auth token with the `spark-admin:workspaces_write` to update workspace settings.

**NOTE**

info.name: Get Workspace Fax Message Available Phone Numbers

params.name: max
params.description: Limit the number of phone numbers returned to this maximum count. The default is 2000.

params.name: start
params.description: Start at the zero-based offset in the list of matching phone numbers. The default is 0.

params.name: phoneNumber
params.description: Filter phone numbers based on the comma-separated list provided in the `phoneNumber` array.

items.docs:
List standard numbers that are available to be assigned as a workspace's FAX message number.
These numbers are associated with the location of the workspace specified in the request URL, can be active or inactive, and are unassigned.

The available numbers APIs help identify candidate numbers and their owning entities to simplify the assignment or association of these numbers to members or features.

Retrieving this list requires a full, read-only or location administrator auth token with a scop
